lede: The gondola replacement takes center stage this week as the Gondola Subcommittee meets Monday to hash out federal funding timelines — SMART needs $18 million committed by fall to enter the FTA program. Mountain Village Council tackles a packed agenda Tuesday including an investigation report review and votes on affordable housing policies, while Norwood's Planning Commission considers new dark sky lighting standards.
